subject: How to convert physical position in position genetics?

messages.author: 9eb7f1fb4cd1058f
messages.subject: How to convert physical position in position genetics?
parts:
Good afternoon
I am in need to convert my data, who are in physical format for Genetic format (cM).
How do I do that?

Thank you.

messages.author: 04e62c3b36bb17bf
messages.subject: Re: How to convert physical position in position genetics?
parts:
Its not so easy - you need to make a genetic map from markers first: some options to do this include R/qtl (http://www.rqtl.org/tutorials/geneticmaps.pdf) and joinMap. 
That will give you a genetic map, in cM. 

If you are working with a model species, there are some resources that give approximate cM based on physical (bp) positions, but those are species- and cross-specific, and are only approximations.
